boundaries.name: rust_data_and_execution
boundaries.obligation: Handwritten native schema/control flow is not a Rust/serde/derive/compiler refinement; integer widths are explicit representation domains, allocation and exact error strings not proved.

boundaries.name: source_transaction_recompute
boundaries.obligation: compute_tx_hash is an exact-argument dependency: actual source helper uses first receiver and ciphertext digests; this wrapper itself searches ANY matching delta and performs no accumulator or source-signature verification.

boundaries.name: native_e3_verifier
boundaries.obligation: verify_withdraw_claim proof parsing, configured security level and semantic decryption correctness are not proved here; only exact argument/error wiring.

boundaries.name: native_key_and_h1
boundaries.obligation: RegevPk validation/Poseidon digest and full BalanceState H1 computation are opaque dependency calls with panic possible; no native Bytes32-to-field canonicality assertion is introduced.

boundaries.name: native_fixed_arrays
boundaries.obligation: BalanceState source fixed1024 arrays are represented as lists; caller representation domain requires those lengths. Direct indexing panic is retained, not silently converted into protocol rejection or assumed impossible.

boundaries.name: codec_and_input_widths
boundaries.obligation: Native Nat inputs stand for Rust u64/u32 values; exact join shift truncation and OR are inherited from proved codec helper but FFI/serde and compiler refinement remain unproved.

boundaries.name: separate_circuit_and_consumer
boundaries.obligation: This helper's success is not proof acceptance and does not derive nullifier, authenticate accumulator/latest final state, prove token registry membership, replay freshness or funds safety.
